title: auto with no solver over a model that states nothing is exit 2, not a green build
note: The case that was missing, and the exact hole it left: exitCodeOf read the ROWS alone, so a run with no rows fell through to 0. The command printed `no solver ran ... this run is exit 2` and exited 0 — the sentence VERIFY_EXIT_CODES exists to make impossible, and every other rule in this file is an implication that holds vacuously over an empty row set.
